I have a 4 node cluster of 8.4. I am upgrading by clearing all the VMs off of a host. Then I shut that node down. I run the command on another node to remove the node from the cluster (pvecm delnode nodename). Then I clean up by running the command (rm -r /etc/pve/nodes/nodename).
